rationale: Both share a near-identical dark/amber editorial art direction with serif italic headlines, a scroll-scrubbed manifesto paragraph and a cream-section rhythm, so the gap is small. A has the cleaner, quicker hero entrance and a strong exploded-cylinder sequence plus a horizontal materials track, but its closing outline 'HALO' wordmark is faint and its hovers are mostly subtle glows and underlines. B's product render is more detailed (knit texture, light seam), its scroll story is more varied (driver-layout diagram, stat counters, two-speaker stereo dots, colour-swatch pre-order card, large metallic HALO footer), and its buttons visibly change fill from ivory to amber with a glow. B's phone layout also keeps richer interactive modules (Conventional/Halo toggle, seat-level radar) without clipping, which tips it slightly ahead.
